meta.title: Retail Demand Decision Engine
meta.source: Zenodo DOI 10.5281/zenodo.10203108 (mirror of the Kaggle competition files)
meta.coverage_note: 30 pre-evaluation high-activity series per store-category pair; 900 total.

metric_contract.primary_accuracy_metric: WAPE = total absolute error / total actual units
metric_contract.commercial_accuracy_metric: Revenue-weighted WAPE using observed weekly selling price
metric_contract.validation_design: Cutoff-safe 28-day holdout; all lagged demand features are at least 28 days old.
metric_contract.uncertainty: Split calibration on the preceding 28 days; category-level 80th percentile weekly absolute error buffer.
metric_contract.inventory_scope: Policy simulation uses unit flows, weekly review, immediate replenishment at review, and no supplier lead-time or holding-cost claims.

data_quality.selection_rule: Top 30 pre-evaluation series within each store-category pair

insights: The global model changes aggregate WAPE by 4.5% versus the strongest calibration-selected baseline.
The weekly order policy fulfills 96.7% of observed unit demand at the calibrated buffer setting.
Forecast bias is 5.3%; the decision queue surfaces series where relative error and demand exposure are highest.
